name: Jaipur
summary: Forts, palaces and old-city bazaars. Hill forts sit north of the city, so they cost real travel time.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: Hilltop fort-palace complex; the ramp and courtyards take time to walk.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Royal residence with courtyards and museum galleries in the walled city.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.description: Five-storey screened facade overlooking the bazaar street.

attractions.name: Albert Hall Museum
attractions.description: State museum of decorative arts, textiles and archaeology.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort
attractions.description: Ridge-top fort with views over the city.

attractions.name: Jal Mahal viewpoint
attractions.description: Palace in Man Sagar lake, seen from the roadside promenade.

attractions.name: Birla Mandir
attractions.description: White marble temple; closed in the early afternoon.

attractions.name: Galtaji Temple
attractions.description: Temple complex built around natural spring-fed tanks in a gorge.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar
attractions.description: Jewellery and textile market inside the old city.

attractions.name: Sisodia Rani Garden
attractions.description: Terraced Mughal-style garden on the Agra road.
